Terms & Conditions

📄 Effective: June 1, 2025

Welcome to Drive Express. By accessing or using this website, you agree to comply with and be bound by the following terms and conditions. These terms govern your use of our automobile management and online booking platform.

⚠️

Continued use of Drive Express constitutes your acceptance of all terms listed here. If you do not agree, please discontinue use of the platform immediately.

01
General

Platform Usage

By accessing or using this website, you agree to comply with and be bound by the following terms and conditions. These terms govern your use of our automobile management and online booking platform.

02
Listings

Listings & Approval

All vehicle listings submitted on Drive Express may go through a review process. The approval of any listing is at the discretion of the platform. Images of vehicles will be visible to buyers only after approval, while other vehicle details will be displayed once the advertisement is live.

03
Plans

Listing Plans

Users are allowed to post one vehicle under the free listing plan. To list more vehicles, users must upgrade to a premium plan. Sellers confirm that all information provided about their vehicle is accurate and truthful.

04
Compliance

Seller Responsibility

The seller is solely responsible for completing and verifying all documents related to the vehicle before finalizing any sale. Drive Express is not responsible for disputes or issues that arise between buyers and sellers.

05
Premium

Premium Listings

Premium listings are valid for a limited period and provide enhanced visibility. Refunds, if applicable, will be processed according to the platform's refund policy and within the specified time period.

06
Disclaimer

No Sale Guarantee

Drive Express does not guarantee the sale of any vehicle. Buyer interest depends on listing quality, including images, vehicle condition, pricing, and accuracy of details.

07
Contact

Communication

By using this website, you authorize Drive Express to contact you via call or message regarding your listing. Any misuse of the platform may result in suspension or permanent removal of the user account.

08
Legal

Disputes & Jurisdiction

Any disputes arising from the use of this platform shall be subject to applicable laws and jurisdiction. Continued use of Drive Express indicates acceptance of all terms and conditions stated above.
